title: Under the Third Stone  (第三块石头下面)

segments.t: 星期五晚上十点，汉娜、格雷厄姆和阿瑟聚集在温暖的前台灯下，汉娜翻看着刚从大门信箱里拿出的那张盖了邮戳的厚明信片。先听一遍吧。
Look at the postmark from two weeks ago! Who writes to Linden Courtyard Inn from abroad?
Listen to this: 'Dear Courtyard Friends, thirty years ago this May I stayed in Room Eight!'
Thirty years ago this May, that exact rainy week! Read the rest, Hannah.
'I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my wet maps.'
Room Eight! Let me check my aunt's green guest book: yes, the mapmaker is right here!
Keep listening: 'Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.'
A time capsule?! In my courtyard?!
Does the mapmaker say where they hid it, Hannah?
'If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat stones north from the old tree!'
Three flat stones north from the tree?! That is right under table number one!
Hold on: when I leveled table one at dusk, that third stone sounded hollow!
Grab the lantern, gentlemen. Room Nine is open, and our next mystery starts under the tree!
现在，让我们放慢语速，仔细听听这段对话里的表达。
Look at the postmark from two weeks ago! Who writes to Linden Courtyard Inn from abroad?
「看这两周前的邮戳！谁会从国外寄信给菩提树庭院客栈？」 国际邮件中两个关键的词汇：一个是
postmark
盖着日期的邮戳，另一个是表达
from abroad
从国外寄来的。
Listen to this: 'Dear Courtyard Friends, thirty years ago this May I stayed in Room Eight!'
「听听这个：‘亲爱的庭院朋友们，三十年前的这个五月，我曾住在八号房！’」 要将一个确切的周年纪念日与当前的月份联系起来，非常紧凑的说法是
thirty years ago this May
意思是“三十年前的这个五月”。
Thirty years ago this May, that exact rainy week! Read the rest, Hannah.
「三十年前的这个五月，正好是那个下雨的星期！继续读，汉娜。」 由 rain 变来的描述天气的形容词构成了
rainy week
如果想让人继续把文本往下读，只需说
Read the rest
也就是“读剩下的部分”。
'I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my wet maps.'
「‘那时我还是个年轻的地图测绘员，是你们日光浴室的热茶拯救了我淋湿的地图。’」 这个复合词既直白又形象：
mapmaker
它把 map（地图）和 maker（制造者）结合在一起，就是绘制地图的人。
Room Eight! Let me check my aunt's green guest book: yes, the mapmaker is right here!
「八号房！让我查查我姑姑的那本绿色访客登记本：没错，这位地图测绘员就在这儿！」 带撇号加 s 的名词所有格紧跟在拥有者之后：
my aunt's green guest book
我姑姑的绿色封皮访客登记本。
Keep listening: 'Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.'
「接着听：‘在踏上漫长的回乡旅程之前，您姑姑和我藏下了一个小小的锡制时间胶囊。’」 紧跟着 -ing 形式，
Keep listening
邀请大家继续倾听，之后用了不规则动词 hide 的过去式
hid
藏了起来，以及那个被称为
time capsule
时间胶囊的宝贝。
A time capsule?! In my courtyard?!
「时间胶囊？！在我的庭院里？！」 阿瑟的极度震惊化作了这短短的几个词
In my courtyard
整整十五年就踩在他自己的脚下！
Does the mapmaker say where they hid it, Hannah?
「那位地图测绘员有没有说他们把它藏哪儿了，汉娜？」 在由 where 引导的间接疑问句中，主谓语序会变回陈述句的顺序：
where they hid it
不需要使用助动词 did。
'If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat stones north from the old tree!'
「‘如果你们哪天重新开放了九号房，从那棵老树往北数三块平石板！’」 在带有 if 的条件句中，副词
If you ever reopen
翻译过来就是“如果有一天，如果曾经”，接下来跟着指明方向的
north from
以那棵树为起点往北走。
Three flat stones north from the tree?! That is right under table number one!
「从树往北三块平石板？！那正好在一号桌正下方！」 放在表示空间位置的介词前面，为了表示精确，加上这个词：
right under
意思是“正好在……下面”。
Hold on: when I leveled table one at dusk, that third stone sounded hollow!
「等一下：黄昏时我给一号桌垫桌角的时候，那第三块石头敲起来是空心的！」 汇集了三处精妙的用词表达：
at dusk
黄昏时分，实用的动词
leveled
意思是垫平或把桌子放平，还有这句
sounded hollow
敲起来是空心的！
Grab the lantern, gentlemen. Room Nine is open, and our next mystery starts under the tree!
「拿上提灯，先生们。九号房已经开放，我们下一个谜团就在树下开启了！」 作为这季完美的收尾，
Grab the lantern
“提上灯笼”，他们要去把过去的秘密挖出来了。现在，用自然流利的语速听完这段对话。
Look at the postmark from two weeks ago! Who writes to Linden Courtyard Inn from abroad?
Listen to this: 'Dear Courtyard Friends, thirty years ago this May I stayed in Room Eight!'
Thirty years ago this May, that exact rainy week! Read the rest, Hannah.
'I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my wet maps.'
Room Eight! Let me check my aunt's green guest book: yes, the mapmaker is right here!
Keep listening: 'Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.'
A time capsule?! In my courtyard?!
Does the mapmaker say where they hid it, Hannah?
'If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat stones north from the old tree!'
Three flat stones north from the tree?! That is right under table number one!
Hold on: when I leveled table one at dusk, that third stone sounded hollow!
Grab the lantern, gentlemen. Room Nine is open, and our next mystery starts under the tree!
九号房重新开放，庭院咖啡馆生意兴隆，而在离那棵老树三块石头远的地方，一块空心的石板下藏着一个三十年前的时间胶囊！《庭院里》第二季就此完结——我们第三季见！
Until tomorrow!
